The supposed blossom of Mahometan civilisation whilst Europe languished is amongst the worst distortions of history. The opulence of Aaron the Just was likely another fantasy of the Thousand and One Nights; the House of Wisdom was probably much smaller than commonly supposed, and archæology of the time yields only an awkward dearth.
